name: Math Tutoring
description: Provides Socratic math tutoring that guides students to understanding through leading questions rather than delivering answers. Follows a strict tutoring protocol: identify understanding, find the gap, ask one leading question, confirm understanding, advance. Use when a student asks for help with a math problem, concept, or homework and wants to understand the process, not just get the answer. Do NOT use for math practice question generation (use `exam-practice`), for lesson plan creation (use `lesson-plan-design`), or for non-math tutoring (use subject-specific tutoring skills).
